GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, ridden along a touch turn, Straightened Up half clear, joined 200m, headed approaching 100m, kept on well # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Pushed fwd & raced behind leader on inside (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 300m & weakened in last 200m. # didn't finish off

(cross-over nose band and tongue control bit first time) Jumped Well from the Inside . Settled Down 3rd the fence 3 Lengths @ 750m. back to 4th Straightening Up Same margin. had a real battle with 3rd all way to line, 1st 2 out 1st 2 home # steady/fine
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped best and Settled Down on fence trailing 0.75 Lengths , held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths rail, Held Up home turn then taken off heels Straightening Up , kept battling to post # battled on fairly

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at 1100m, held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead at the 220m, Headed 200m and Lost Ground to the line. [Stewards: Raced keenly from 1200m and through middle stages.] # weakening 3rd place
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping. Passing the 1200m commenced to race keenly when being restrained to obtain cover and continued to do so throughout the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Four Wide , Made Some Ground to 2 Lengths Four Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out abruptly on jumping. Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked 4-w Straightening Up and picked up a couple of length down the centre of track in straight. First start: Need to see again. # ran on fairly
